protocol.new_station_rule: Russian ICAO stations active throughout2022-2024, outside every station in all earlier inventories; nearest8 by fixed squared geographic distance to reference; no labels or file availability used to pick sites
protocol.new_station_scoring: All registered sites and years reported; score each station-year with>=30 complete14-hour nights; no replacement of sparse sites; 2024 uses calibration2023, 2025/2026 use calibration2024
protocol.validation: Whole calendar-week exclusion with2-day purge across ALL calibration stations, plus exclude query station from regional bank. Retrospective prior validation, not independent coverage guarantee
protocol.tails: Observed-cold labels allowed ONLY in calibration bank; one maximum signed overprediction per date, not one independent sample per site; apply tail from forecast-only risk and station elevation
protocol.selection: Each prior year primary overall/cold coverage and regional macro site overall/cold coverage must not decrease; warm width<=1.10 and all width<=1.15 times prior baseline. Rank cold uncovered rate averaged by scope, cold/warm interval score, width. Otherwise preserve previous range
protocol.points: Original unweighted Huber only on reference349290; GFS point on every other station. Separate residual banks for each anchor; never transfer Huber point or detector to new sites
protocol.detector: Immutable original event_duration_weather@0.25; verify probability, event, mask and timing on reference; unsupported on new stations
protocol.deployment: Research only; no field routing changes, no probability of apple damage, no automatic protection command
protocol.status: Registry fixed before new comparisons;2025/2026 reference controls previously viewed; new stations unopened until all choices and sources frozen

new_station_audit.eligibility_uses: complete nights only; all registered sites retained, no substitutions
